changelog: v0.2.2: NEW Add New Supplier panel in Suppliers section (supplier name required, plus contact, mobile, WhatsApp, email, GSTIN, state, address, opening balance, credit limit, payment terms, notes) with a Supplier Directory table; auto-update channel is now pre-filled to the official GitHub channel on fresh installs and on existing installs where no channel was set (a user-chosen channel is never overwritten); auto-updater no longer tries to overwrite the running python-win interpreter or launcher exe, which could break an update on Windows.
